title: Chỉ số ‘Cực Sợ Hãi’ quay lại — nhưng người mới lại hay bỏ lỡ khoảnh khắc vàng
subTitle:
Chỉ số Fear & Greed của thị trường crypto lại rơi về vùng Extreme Fear – mức từng xuất hiện trong những giai đoạn căng thẳng nhất của các chu kỳ giảm trước đây. 
Tâm lý chung của thị trường đang rất yếu và lượng nhà đầu tư hoảng loạn tăng mạnh.
Khi ai cũng sợ, đó lại thường là lúc xuất hiện nhiều cơ hội nhất. 
Lịch sử cho thấy các vùng “cực sợ hãi” thường trùng với thời điểm mà những nhà đầu tư có kinh nghiệm bắt đầu gom hàng từ từ.
Ngược lại, người mới thường phản ứng theo cảm xúc: vừa thấy giá giảm mạnh là bán tháo, vô tình rơi đúng vào “bẫy tâm lý”, bán ngay đáy rồi đứng ngoài tiếc nuối khi thị trường phục hồi.
Kinh nghiệm cho newbie: 
Nếu bạn vẫn còn vốn và không bị kẹp quá nặng, hãy xem giai đoạn này như cơ hội để quan sát và chuẩn bị.
Mua khi người khác hoảng vẫn là chiến lược đúng — nhưng chỉ khi bạn có kế hoạch rõ ràng: xác định vùng mua, đặt stop-loss, và luôn vào vốn nhỏ, chia nhiều phần.
Không nên mua theo cảm xúc “sợ bỏ lỡ”, và càng không nên all-in trong lúc thị trường chưa có tín hiệu ổn định.
Khi thị trường cảm xúc cực đoan, điều bạn cần nhất không phải là hành động vội – mà là sự bình tĩnh để nhìn rõ xu hướng thật.
Cảm xúc không phải kẻ thù. Nhưng nếu bạn để cảm xúc lái quyết định của mình, bạn sẽ luôn là người thua trước.

Don't track the giant whales anymore! The dealer laughs: Another fat whale has fallen into the liquidation trap, how can retail investors avoid accompanying the burial?

There are no myths in the market, only the 'giant whales' being hunted and the lurking hunters.

Last night, Bitcoin surged 2% in just five minutes. A short seller who had heavily invested $120 million collapsed in a chain liquidation. The largest single liquidation amounted to a staggering $96.51 million, making it the most brutal single loss in the entire network this year. Not only did he lose his short position in Bitcoin, but positions in XRP, ZEC, and others also fell one after another, with account assets plummeting from $6.57 million to $1.47 million, ultimately leaving in disgrace.

Looking back at his trading records since November, he has been on a roller coaster of heavy losses and small gains, repeatedly defeated yet persistently fighting, but he has never managed to turn things around.

In my opinion, this is no coincidence. This is a typical 'precision strike'. The dealer is well aware of the positions of large holdings, pulling up - blasting - and falling back, a seamless set of actions with a clear target.

What you think of as 'giant whales' are merely larger prey in the eyes of the controller. No matter how strong the capital, once trapped in someone else's game, it is just a pawn being used.
So how should ordinary investors position themselves?

Do not blindly follow the whales; they are not market prophets and may even be more emotional and stubborn than you. Stay away from the temptation of high leverage; liquidation happens quickly, profits can be high, but that is not investing, it's gambling with your life. Learn to interpret the liquidation heatmap; dealers often target densely liquidated areas, avoiding these zones can help you dodge most sudden risks.

Be patient in capturing liquidation rebounds. After a whale is liquidated, the market often experiences a brief counter-trend volatility, which is the time for light position trial trades.

Remember: In this market, you don't have to become a whale, 
but you must learn to fish steadily amidst the storms of the whale fights, withdrawing calmly.
Do you want to know where the next giant whale liquidation might happen?

The market is never short of opportunities; what it lacks is calm and strategy. You Yuan will continue to track on-chain movements, steadily advancing with everyone. 回看此人交易记录，自十一月以来，他几乎一路大亏小赚，屡败屡战，却始终未能翻身。

#Home Gas
⛽ Gas Abstraction in Defi App (HOME)
Defi App is designed to greatly simplify the user experience by removing one of the main barriers in DeFi — managing gas tokens.
1. Gas Abstraction: The platform uses the concept of account abstraction (based on EIP-4337 standards), which allows separating the payment of gas fees from the necessity to hold the native token of the network (for example, #ETH  for Ethereum or #sol  for Solana).
2. HOME token as a universal payment token: In fact, the platform allows paying fees (or takes them on itself) using its native token $HOME. If you have $HOME , the app automatically handles gas payments in the background.
3. Sponsoring fees: Moreover, Defi App can sponsor gas fees through supported networks, which means that for the user, transactions appear as "gasless" (Gasless Transactions), eliminating the need to hold any gas tokens.

#Home Gas
⛽ Абстракция газа в Defi App (HOME)
Defi App спроектирован для того, чтобы максимально упростить опыт пользователя, устраняя один из главных барьеров в DeFi — управление токенами газа.
1. Абстракция газа (Gas Abstraction): Платформа использует концепцию абстракции учетных записей (на основе стандартов EIP-4337), которая позволяет отделить оплату комиссий за газ от необходимости держать нативный токен сети (например, #ETH  для Ethereum или #sol  для Solana).
2. Токен HOME как универсальный платежный токен: Фактически, платформа позволяет оплачивать комиссии (или берет их на себя) с помощью своего нативного токена $HOME. Если у вас есть $HOME , приложение автоматически обрабатывает платежи за газ в фоновом режиме.
3. Спонсирование комиссий: Более того, Defi App может спонсировать газовые сборы через поддерживаемые сети, что означает, что для пользователя транзакции выглядят как "безгазовые" (Gasless Transactions), что устраняет необходимость держать какие-либо токены газа.

💥 杠杆不是洪水猛兽，爆仓才是懵操作的锅


币圈聊天框里最常见的对话：“敢上 20 倍杠杆不？”“我上次 5 倍都快爆仓了！”

先说实话：把爆仓怪杠杆，跟摔跟头怪地板滑一样。杠杆只是放大器，对的操作能把 3% 波动变 30%，收益翻十倍；错的操作，只会把亏损放大。


我见过的离谱操作太多：




止损当摆设，跌了硬扛；




跟大V梭哈，买在山顶；




半夜盯盘，涨两点狂喜，跌一点恐慌割肉。




杠杆从来都是“嫌贫爱富”——只给有准备的人当加速器，给瞎操作的人当爆仓神器。我常年盯盘，老炮用 15 倍杠杆多年从没爆过，秘诀很简单：


1️⃣ 判断要毒：趋势明确再出手，别听群里喊必涨。

2️⃣ 出手要稳：单仓不超过本金 10%，稳得住才有下波机会。

The Crypto Market Has Been Down Lately — What’s the Reason?

It may have several reasons, which are mentioned as follows:

1. Regulatory Pressure or Negative News
- Tougher regulations from the U.S. or other major countries.
- Legal action or investigations by the SEC against exchanges or crypto projects.

2. Economic Pressures
- Interest rate hikes by the U.S. Federal Reserve or other central banks.
- A stronger U.S. dollar often reduces the value of riskier assets like crypto.

3. Fear, Uncertainty, and Doubt (FUD)
- Negative rumors or news lead people to sell their assets in panic.
- Whales (large holders) sometimes sell suddenly, causing sharp market drops.

4. Project Failures or Hacks
- If a major project is hacked or collapses, the entire market reacts negatively.

5. Technical Corrections
- After long bullish trends, markets naturally correct to stabilize.

Note: These conditions are often temporary. Many believe strong crypto projects remain solid, and some investors see this as a buying opportunity while prices are low.

title: Ethereum Approaches Key Support: Long-Term Holders Indicate Recovery in Unstable Markets
subTitle:
In the ever-changing world of cryptocurrency, #Ethereum is at a crucial point. Trading at $2,967.76 after a sharp 23.4% drop over the past month, the second-largest digital asset by market cap is testing important support levels. However, despite the turbulence, there are signs of strength long-term investors are quietly increasing their positions, suggesting a possible turnaround.
The Impact of Recent Pressures
Market instability has affected Ethereum, driven by widespread economic uncertainties that resemble the chaos of past downturns. Just months ago, in April 2025, global economic policy indicators rose to levels not seen since the pandemic, pushing the price below critical thresholds. Currently, Ethereum is about 8% above its Accumulation Addresses Realized Price a benchmark that reflects the average purchase price for holders who buy during difficult periods and hold through market cycles.
This metric is more than just a number; it's an indicator of confidence. Historically, drops below this level have been rare and short-lived, often marking the lowest point of corrections before upward movement returns. As selling pressure decreases, Ethereum's closeness to this support highlights a critical moment for short-term traders and a buying opportunity for committed investors.
Accumulation Trends: A Sign of Confidence from Experienced Investors
Despite the turmoil, long-term holders are increasing their investments. In 2025 alone, an impressive 17 million Ethereum tokens have moved into accumulation wallets, increasing their total balance from 10 million to over 27 million coins. These aren't speculative buys; they're strategic investments from investors who see dips as opportunities in a maturing asset class.
This behavior is consistent with patterns seen in previous cycles, where such accumulations preceded significant recoveries. Instead of giving up, these holders are betting on Ethereum's essential role in decentralized finance and smart contracts, even as external shocks test the network's strength.
Charting the Path: Key Technical Indicators
Looking at the weekly charts, Ethereum is holding onto structural support near its 200-week moving average a reliable level that has supported major rebounds in the past. Last week's brief drop below this line led to a quick recovery, demonstrating the level's defensive strength.
Above, the 50-week moving average acts as a significant resistance. A strong move above it could trigger bullish momentum, changing the narrative from correction to consolidation. Conversely, a fall below current supports could accelerate towards lower realized price zones, increasing instability.
These combined indicators suggest cautious optimism: Ethereum's price action is similar to pullbacks earlier in 2025, where tests of long-term floors attracted institutional investments and set the stage for gains.
Looking Ahead: Recovery on the Horizon?
As Ethereum navigates this unstable period, the combination of on-chain accumulation and technical resilience provides a strong argument for recovery. Long-term holders aren't just holding; they're expanding their positions, setting the asset up for its next growth phase. In a market characterized by extremes, this mix of data-driven strength and historical precedent reminds us that true value often becomes most apparent during times of doubt. For investors, the question isn't whether Ethereum will rebound, but how strongly it will rise when it does.

subTitle:
When the whole market bursts into laughter at the guy who claimed BTC would blast to 220000 in just forty five days I pause for a moment because sometimes the idea that looks the most foolish ends up being the one nobody was brave enough to consider
We have seen this pattern again and again
When the crowd screams bear market when fear fills every chart when timelines talk only about collapse that is often the moment the market quietly prepares its biggest reversal
Why I think this moment is different
BTC slipped under 90000 ETH lost its grip on 3000 and the entire space feels like it is sinking
But here is the part most people forget
The giants of this industry fall slowly but rise like rockets
The market has been grinding down for so long that even a small spark could turn into a massive ignition
Imagine this scenario
BTC drops to 70000 in the next month
Then suddenly liquidity floods back in
Panic turns into FOMO
And a violent rebound sends it into a level no one dared to predict
In crypto the impossible becomes normal faster than anyone expects
My accumulation mindset
Instead of chasing BTC and ETH at their premium prices I am focusing on two assets that feel like sleeping beasts waiting for someone to wake them up
BNB
Steady strong impossible to push down for long
It is the quiet tank of this market
Every dip feels like a gift and the lower it goes the louder it calls to be accumulated
SOL
Energy speed momentum
It already carries its own ecosystem story and it moves the market like a heartbeat
For long term conviction SOL is a storm waiting for the right wind
How I split positions depending on size
Small stacks under 10000 focus mainly on BNB
Medium stacks between 10000 and 20000 lean heavy on BNB but sprinkle in SOL for explosive potential
Large stacks above 20000 can afford to reach further into quality alts like ASTER and GIGGLE
Why I like ASTER and GIGGLE right now
ASTER does something rare
When the market bleeds it refuses to follow
It has that strange strength that early top ten projects used to show and I would not be shocked if it broke into four digits someday
GIGGLE is the memecoin of this cycle in my view
Running on BSC with an attitude completely different from the rest of the market
When others dip GIGGLE casually rises like it does not care what BTC is doing
And remember this
When the next major bull cycle begins the BSC ecosystem historically becomes the spear at the front of the charge
Positioning in strong BSC assets before the crowd returns is planting seeds before the rain comes
So the question now is simple
Do you dare to bottom fish when the world is afraid

quoteContent.title: Bitcoin back in the blue territory! Buy the dip!
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly:
Also known as the "fire sale" territory, the blue zone is where fortunes have historically been made. As the old saying goes, "buy when blood is running in the streets", and right now, the market is swimming in metaphorical blood. Or at least, it seems so, when you look at retail sentiment. The reality is different.
{spot}(BTCUSDT)

👉🏻 First, let's do a reality check for all newcomers: Bitcoin is down 27% from its all-time high from last month. In the 2017 bull market, Bitcoin had 6 dips of 30% or more. And in the current bull cycle alone, Bitcoin had 7 dips of 20% or more. So, what we are seeing right now: it's called Monday. Basically, any Monday (almost).
{spot}(ETHUSDT)

👉🏻 Second, let's analyze what is happening. Bitcoin's price tends to behave like a high-risk tech stock (Amazon, Tesla, Google, Meta). Not because there is any reason to do so, but because the traditional market does not know what else to do with Bitcoin than compare it to what it knows that also shows high growth and high volatility. And since the likelihood of a December interest rate cut by the US Federal Reserve has gone down, high-risk stocks value goes down (financial logic: higher interest rate means that you discount future cash flows more, thus the current value of the stock is lower). And thus, in traditional finance minds, Bitcoin's price should go comparatively down, so they are selling.
{spot}(BNBUSDT)

This is proof that (a big part of) the market has still not understood Bitcoin yet. The fundamentals that make a stock valuable are completely different from the fundamentals that make Bitcoin valuable. They should not move in tandem. If anything, they should be negatively correlated.

But, also as they say: "markets can stay irrational longer than you can stay solvent". So, don't bet on short-term moves. It can go up or down tomorrow. I don't know, and I don't care either.

Zoom out and ask yourself: has the narrative for Bitcoin changed? Let's see:
Will central banks keep printing fiat until it no longer holds any value? Yes✅Will people still be looking for an alternative to ever-depreciating fiat? Yes✅More generally, is Bitcoin still scarce, durable, divisible, portable, accepted, fungible, immutable, and decentralized? Yes. More than ever✅
So, what are you doing? You can panic or you can take advantage of this rare opportunity to buy cheap sats in the blue zone💹

比特币正经历自由落体式下跌，交易员正在为更大规模的跌势做准备。
周一比特币跌破91,500美元，延续了近期的暴跌走势。期权市场数据显示，交易员对9万美元、8.5万美元和8万美元等下行点位的保护性需求大幅飙升，押注11月底到期的看跌合约规模已超过7.4亿美元。
专注去中心化金融的Ergonia研究总监Chris Newhouse表示：
随着过去六个月累积头寸的买家发现自己已经严重套牢，基于信念的多头需求正变得越来越疲软。
数据分析平台CoinMarketCap编制的情绪指数显示加密货币参与者陷入"极度恐慌"状态。市场上挤满了投资者，他们亏损太深，无法继续买入，但又不愿止损。
"加密货币财库公司"承压
痛苦集中体现在所谓的数字资产"财库公司"身上。
这些公司今年早些时候囤积了大量加密货币，试图在股市中成为加密货币囤积概念股。
尽管Michael Saylor的Strategy近期又购买了价值8.35亿美元的比特币，但他的许多同行正面临越来越大的压力，需要出售资产以保护其资产负债表。
Amberdata衍生品总监Greg Magadini表示这种抛售造成了心理压力，他指出：
以太坊非常容易受到这种趋势的影响，因为目前最大的数字资产财库公司都处于亏损状态。

从以太坊当前 1 小时 K 线结构来看，ETH 的整体走势与比特币类似，同属短周期的弱趋势区间。价格持续运行在各级均线下方，短期均线（白色）、中期均线（蓝色）与长期均线（黄色）形成 梯度向下的空头排列，并呈现明显发散态势。这种均线结构通常意味着空头趋势稳定、卖压占优，且即便出现反弹，也更可能被均线压制，难以构成趋势性反转。
从 K 线结构观察，ETH 近期多次在跌破关键价格后出现弱势回抽，但每次反弹的高点均明显低于前一波，典型的“低点不断下移、高点不断下降”，符合下跌趋势通道的特征。图中也缺乏放量长下影、强势反包等止跌信号，表明多头尚未展现出有效介入力量，底部筹码尚不稳定。
RSI 方面，1 小时周期指标长期在 30–40 的弱势区间来回震荡，说明市场动能偏弱，买盘缺乏连续性。虽然图表显示近期 RSI 有超卖后的技术弹升，但仍未突破 50 的趋势中轴线，代表反弹更多源于对下跌动能的修复，而非趋势反转信号。若 RSI 未能持续站稳 50 以上，则弱势格局大概率延续。

quoteContent.title: 参议员要求调查特朗普家族关联加密公司World Liberty Financial
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly:
Odaily星球日报讯 据 CNBC 消息，美国参议员 Elizabeth Warren 和 Jack Reed 致信司法部和财政部，要求对与美国总统特朗普家族密切关联的加密公司 World Liberty Financial 展开调查，原因是该公司涉嫌将其 $WLFI 代币出售给与朝鲜和俄罗斯等非法行为者相关的实体，引发国家安全风险担忧。

参议员引述非营利机构 Accountable.US 的一份报告，该报告称 WLF 向“高度可疑实体”出售了 $WLFI 代币。这些实体在区块链上被发现与受制裁的朝鲜黑客组织 Lazarus Group、俄罗斯“卢布支持的规避制裁工具”、伊朗加密交易所和 Tornado Cash 等有交易关联。

WLF 网站显示，Eric Trump、Donald Trump Jr. 和 Barron Trump 为联合创始人，实体 DT Marks DEFI LLC（与总统及其家族成员关联）持有 WLF 的主要股权，并有权获得 75% 的 $WLFI 代币销售收益。

参议员们认为，向这些实体出售治理代币不仅使特朗普家族直接获利，还可能使非法行为者获得对 WLF 治理的影响力，表明 WLF “缺乏强有力的制裁和反洗钱控制”，并警告这“有超级助长非法金融活动的风险”。

translatedData.body: Senators Request Investigation into Trump Family-Linked Cryptocurrency Company World Liberty Financial
translatedData.bodyTextOnly:
Odaily Planet Daily News According to CNBC, U.S. Senators Elizabeth Warren and Jack Reed sent a letter to the Department of Justice and the Department of the Treasury, requesting an investigation into the cryptocurrency company World Liberty Financial, which is closely associated with U.S. President Trump's family, due to allegations that the company sold its $WLFI token to entities related to illegal actors such as North Korea and Russia, raising concerns about national security.

The senators cited a report from the nonprofit organization Accountable.US, which stated that WLF sold $WLFI tokens to 'highly suspicious entities.' These entities were found on the blockchain to have trading links with the sanctioned North Korean hacker group Lazarus Group, Russia's 'ruble-backed sanctions evasion tools,' Iranian cryptocurrency exchanges, and Tornado Cash.

title: The Buy-Back-and-Burn Mechanism: A Self-Sustaining Loop for Linea Value
subTitle:
Linea’s token model introduces one of the cleanest and most transparent value accrual systems in the L2 space. It’s simple, elegant, and built to scale automatically with network usage. And honestly, once you understand how the loop works, the long-term implications become very clear.
Here’s the basic flow: a user makes a transaction on #Linea and pays the fee in #ETH . From there, roughly 20 percent of that ETH is burned at the Ethereum base layer. This strengthens ETH itself while keeping Linea aligned with Ethereum’s long-term deflationary model.
But the magic happens with the remaining ETH. Instead of sitting idle or going into a treasury, it gets used to buy Linea tokens directly from the open market. After the buy-back, those Linea tokens aren’t recycled or distributed — they’re burned permanently. Meaning every transaction helps slowly reduce total supply.
That’s the loop: users pay ETH → some ETH is burned → the rest buys Linea → $LINEA gets burned.
No complicated governance votes. No confusing reward schedules. Just a straightforward economic engine that turns network usage into automatic token scarcity. The more the chain is used, the faster the supply tightens.
This is especially powerful for long-term holders and builders who believe Linea adoption will grow. If daily activity increases across DeFi, gaming, RWAs, and social apps, then so does buy-back pressure. And with a fixed supply, those burns really start to matter.
The real question isn’t whether the mechanism works — it’s how much daily transaction volume is needed to push the system into hyper-deflationary territory.
So what do you think: how much daily Linea volume would be enough to supercharge this buy-back-and-burn engine?

#zec 2016 In 2016, I stepped into the cryptocurrency market with 5000U, watching people around me mortgage their properties due to contract liquidations, while my account's curve consistently rose at a 45° angle, with the maximum drawdown never exceeding 8%. 
#ETH  Not relying on insider information, not blindly chasing airdrops, and definitely not believing in K-line mysticism—I treat the market as a game that requires precise calculations, positioning myself as the 'trader' who controls the rhythm:

#beat  First tactic: Lock in profits with compound interest, giving profits a 'bulletproof vest'. 
The moment I open a position, I immediately set stop-loss and take-profit orders, leaving no chance for market fluctuations. Whenever profits reach 10% of the principal, I promptly withdraw 50% to a cold wallet, and the remaining is reinvested with 'free profits'. 
If the market continues to rise, I can enjoy the compounded benefits; if the market reverses, I may lose at most half of my profits, with my principal remaining as stable as a mountain. Over 5 years, I've withdrawn profits 45 times, with a single week seeing a withdrawal of 220,000U, even being asked for video verification by the exchange's customer service, concerned about money laundering.

Second tactic: Build positions in a staggered manner, treating the liquidation points of retail investors as 'codes'. 
I simultaneously monitor three timeframes: daily, 4-hour, and 15-minute charts: using the daily chart to set the major direction, the 4-hour chart to find the range, and the 15-minute chart to catch precise entry points. 
For the same cryptocurrency, I open two orders: Order A waits to go long after breaking key levels, with stop-loss placed just below the daily chart's recent low; Order B places a limit sell order in the 4-hour overbought zone. Both orders' stop-losses are controlled within 1.5% of the principal, with take-profits set at five times or more. 
The market spends 80% of its time in consolidation; while others frequently face liquidations, I can profit from both sides with these two orders.

Third tactic: Stop-loss equals high profits, small wounds trade for big stocks. 
I never view stop-losses as losses, but rather as 'entry tickets'—using a small risk of 1.5% to seize the opportunity of a trend. 
When the market is good, I adjust the take-profit to let profits run freely; when the market turns bad, I decisively stop-loss and exit, never holding on. 
Finally, here are three key operational points you can use directly: 
- Divide funds into 10 portions, using at most 1 portion for a single trade, while holding no more than 3 portions to diversify risks; 
- If I incur two consecutive losses, I immediately shut down and go to the gym, absolutely not opening a 'revenge trade' to avoid emotions affecting my judgment; 
These methods are actually quite simple, but most people fail to execute them because they go against human nature—the market is never afraid of you making wrong judgments, but it fears that you won't recover after a liquidation.

#zec 2016年带着5000U踏入币圈，看着身边人因合约爆仓抵押房产，我的账户曲线却始终45°向上，本金最大回抽从未超过8%。
#ETH 不靠内幕消息，不盲目撸空投，更不信K线玄学——我只把市场当作一场需要精密计算的博弈，自己做掌控节奏的“操盘手”:

#beat 第一招：锁盈复利，给利润穿“防弹衣”
开单的瞬间，就把止盈、止损单挂好，不给行情波动留一丝侥幸空间。每当盈利达到本金的10%，立刻提取50%到冷钱包，剩下的用“白来的利润”继续滚仓。
行情接着涨，就能享受复利带来的收益叠加；万一行情反转，顶多回吐一半利润，本金始终稳如泰山。5年里，我累计提过45次盈利，单周最高提过22万U，甚至被交易所客服要求视频核实，担心账户涉及洗黑钱。

第二招：错位建仓，把韭菜爆仓点当“密码”
同时紧盯日线、4小时、15分钟三个周期：用日线定大方向，4小时找震荡区间，15分钟抓精准入场点。
针对同一币种开两张单：A单等突破关键点位后追多，止损直接放在日线前低；B单提前在4小时超买区挂限价空单。两张单的止损都控制在本金的1.5%以内，止盈则设为5倍以上。
市场80%的时间都在震荡，别人在震荡中频繁爆仓，我却能靠这两张单两边赚钱。

第三招：止损即暴利，小伤口换大牛股
我从不把止损看作亏损，而是当成入场“门票”——用1.5%的小风险，去换抓住趋势的机会。
行情好的时候，就移动止盈让利润尽情奔跑；行情走坏，果断止损离场，绝不恋
最后，再给你3个实操关键点，记好就能直接用：
- 资金分成10份，单次开单最多用1份，同时持仓不超过3份，分散风险；
- 连亏2单就立刻关机去健身，绝对不开“复仇单”，避免情绪影响判断；
这些方法其实很简单，但大多人做不到，因为它反人性——市场从不怕你判断出错，就怕你爆仓后再也爬不起来。

title: 🎢 Ethereum's Rollercoaster: Is the Bull Ride Over or Just Taking a Breather?
subTitle:
The crypto market is doing what it does best—keeping everyone on the edge of their seat. And in the center ring of this volatility circus is $ETH , which has seen its price slide below the psychological $3,000 mark recently, sparking heated debates: is the bull run over, or is this just a dramatic, albeit painful, dip before the next leap?
​📉 The Hard Numbers: A Week in the Red
​Looking at the charts, it's clear ETH has been under pressure. Over the past week, the price has seen a significant correction, falling roughly -15% from its prior highs (around $3,550 down to the $3,000-$3,100 range). This plunge has wiped out gains and pushed the asset far from its all-time high of nearly $4,950 recorded a few months ago.
​What's driving the sell-off?
​Macro Headwinds: Broader global market uncertainty and "risk-off" sentiment often hit speculative assets like crypto the hardest.
​Institutional Outflows: Reports suggest that institutional investors, particularly those in newly approved $ETH -related Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs), have been pulling capital, moderating the optimism that initially drove the price up.
​On-Chain Jitters: Analysts note a decline in on-chain activity and a drop in the Total Value Locked (TVL) on the network, signaling that even within the ecosystem, enthusiasm is waning compared to earlier months.
​💡 The Tech Angle: Builders vs. Traders
​While the market mood is gloomy, the developers haven't stopped building. The fundamental engine of Ethereum continues to hum with significant developments that offer a longer-term bullish narrative.
​The "Digital Oil" vs. "Digital Gold" Debate: Blockchain analytics show that ETH holders are far more active in moving and spending their coins than Bitcoin holders. This reflects Ethereum's core function as "digital oil"—the necessary fuel for Decentralized Applications (dApps), DeFi, and NFTs. This inherent utility, compared to Bitcoin's role as a pure "digital gold" store of value, suggests a continuous baseline demand beyond mere speculation.
​The Fusaka Upgrade: A major Layer 1 performance upgrade, code-named Fusaka, is scheduled for December. These planned network enhancements are vital for improving efficiency and increasing "blob throughput," which directly impacts the user experience and scalability—key ingredients for sustained growth.
​Real-World Assets (RWA): The tokenization of real-world assets (like stocks, bonds, and real estate) on the Ethereum blockchain is a massive narrative. A recent regulatory nod to Ethereum's ERC-3643 standard is seen as a turning point that could unlock a trillion-dollar market, integrating traditional finance with the decentralized world.
​🔮 The Long-Term View: Bargain Hunting?
​For long-term believers, this correction is seen through a different lens. On-chain data indicates that the current price levels are edging toward the "Accumulation Addresses Realized Price"—a key metric that has historically acted as a magnet for long-term buyers in previous market cycles. In simpler terms, big-money holders view this zone as a "bargain" opportunity.
​The ongoing battle is centered around the $3,000 level and key support around $2,800-$2,900. If sellers break through these floors, the pain could continue. However, the confluence of institutional interest, crucial network upgrades, and the enduring utility of the platform as the cornerstone of the decentralized web provides a strong foundation against a complete collapse.
​In the world of Ethereum, the market is a chaotic blend of short-term fear and long-term conviction. The current drop is a stern test of investor resolve, but the underlying technological evolution suggests that the platform's story is far from over.#Ethereum #ETH #WriteToEarnUpgrade

title: 惊天预言！50周线已破，熊市铁证如山！现在不看这篇，明天爆仓别哭！
subTitle:
完了，行情可能真要转向熊市了。关键信号已经出现：比特币跌破了50周周线，这在技术上通常被看作熊市确认的标志。
之前大家一直关注的92000美元附近的“期货缺口”现在也失守了，价格很可能会继续下探，去回补那个缺口。一旦补上，大概率会跌破9万美元。
跌破之后，也许会吸引一些抄底资金进场，带动一波反弹。但重点来了——反弹不等于趋势反转。除非价格能重新站稳50周周线以上，否则反弹很可能只是“死猫跳”，是给你减仓的机会，而不是追涨的信号。反弹后，市场可能还会继续下跌，甚至引发新一轮恐慌。
那么问题来了，这轮下跌到底是谁在卖？买盘又去哪了？有一个现象值得注意：长期持币者这30天里也卖出了几十万枚比特币。他们一般不是恐慌抛售，更多是在牛市后半段正常获利了结。以前牛市里，市场总有足够的买盘接住这些抛压，但现在情况变了——买盘跟不上了。
需求疲软是核心问题。美国比特币现货ETF资金不再持续流入，反而在大幅流出。代表美国机构情绪的Coinbase溢价也一直是负的，说明大资金不是在买，而是在卖。市场供需失衡，卖压大于买盘，价格自然撑不住。
再看大户动向：10月底进场的那批“新鲸鱼”，成本在11万美元左右，现在整体被套。11月初他们单日亏损就曾超过5亿美元。而“老鲸鱼”则相对淡定，整体持仓还在缓慢增加。这说明砸盘的主要是扛不住波动的新大户和短线玩家。
更值得警惕的是传统金融市场传来的信号。据说美联储和几家大银行最近开了紧急闭门会议，讨论银行间短期借贷市场压力过大的问题。简单说，就是银行之间突然都很缺现金，而且他们宁愿花更高利息借钱，也不愿用美联储提供的优惠紧急贷款渠道。为什么？因为怕暴露自己“缺钱”，这就像一个人渴死了却不肯接矿泉水，非要买奶茶装面子。这个信号非常危险，说明金融体系内部流动性可能非常紧张。
而现在美联储处境也很尴尬：通胀压力仍在，12月降息概率已低于50%，想靠“放水”救市短期内基本没戏。
我的判断是：熊市已经确认。技术面和情绪面都已转熊。下跌原因一方面是做市商漏洞引发的狙击、恐慌抛售和长线玩家获利了结，另一方面是ETF买盘枯竭，导致供需失衡。
当前市场情绪极端恐慌，这通常意味着短期底部临近，但抄底必须有承受进一步下跌的心理和资金准备。如果反弹不能收复50周周线，就可能是假反弹。如果传统金融市场的流动性问题不解决，我认为下一只“黑天鹅”可能还在后面。
操作上，我的建议是：短线现货可以考虑减仓，长线玩家可以不动，合约玩家要特别谨慎。具体怎么操作，欢迎找到宥媛交流！

title: Ôm alt khi Bitcoin đang lao dốc – sai lầm quen thuộc của người mới
subTitle:
Bitcoin rơi mạnh, nhưng nhiều altcoin còn giảm sâu hơn. 
Dù vậy, không ít người mới vẫn cố giữ alt với hy vọng chúng sẽ bật lại.
Khi thị trường chung mất ổn định, altcoin là nhóm chịu ảnh hưởng nặng nhất do thanh khoản ít và độ tin cậy thấp hơn.
Giữ alt ở thời điểm này đồng nghĩa với rủi ro tăng gấp nhiều lần, đặc biệt với người mới chưa hiểu chu kỳ thị trường.
Cách an toàn hơn là ưu tiên Bitcoin hoặc giữ stablecoin để bảo toàn vốn. 
Chờ khi thị trường ổn định, tín hiệu rõ ràng hơn rồi hãy quay lại alt – lúc đó cơ hội cũng sẽ rõ ràng và ít rủi ro hơn.
Khi Bitcoin còn chưa đứng vững, altcoin gần như chắc chắn “đổ theo”.
Muốn chơi altcoin, trước hết phải quan sát sức khỏe của Bitcoin. BTC mạnh thì alt mới có cửa sống.

Keep your bullets until the model truly shows a bottom, and you will be smarter than 80% of people.

这几天大家情绪都很疲惫，希望来一根“千军万马”的大阳线把阴霾一扫而空——但市场往往不会在你想要的地方亮灯，它更喜欢先把泡沫挤干净，再让人重新燃起兴趣。

换个角度讲：后面有降息预期、美财政部的资金流动、高风险资产的轮动……这些都不是坏事。只是当美股、黄金、大饼全都在高位的时候，泡沫太满，市场不清理一下，谁来接力？所以现在的震荡和回吐，本质上是“排水”。

只要三日线没有走出明显的底部结构，就说明这轮泡沫还没挤完。这个阶段需要的不是激情，而是耐心：
把子弹留到模型真正走出底部，你就比八成的人都聪明。

现在最明智的就是小仓试单，大仓等位；
跌的时候不要慌，记住一个核心逻辑：
稳定币法案是为了美方化债，#BTC 和#ETH 的位置太关键，不会轻易被放弃。
盘面走得再深，也改变不了这盘棋的大方向。

#ETH🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥 #ETH 📈 Ethereum (ETH) — November 2025 Brief Analysis

1. Price Action & Market Tone

ETH recently dipped toward $3,100 support amid a broader crypto sell-off.

But it's recovered to around $3,450–$3,550, driven by whale accumulation and some macro tailwinds.

On-chain metrics suggest less ETH on exchanges, indicating lower selling pressure.

2. Big Fundamental Driver: The Fusaka Upgrade

A major catalyst: the Fusaka hard fork, scheduled for December 3, 2025, is gaining hype.

Key features: PeerDAS (data availability sampling), Verkle Trees, and other EIPs that will increase capacity, reduce costs, and make Layer-2 rollups more efficient.

This could drive greater L2 usage, making Ethereum even more competitive for DeFi, gaming, and payments.

3. Institutional Interest & ETF Flows

There is still strong institutional demand, partly via Ethereum-based ETFs.

Analysts see further upside potential, with $5,000+ being a realistic resistance area if momentum builds.

On the flip side, some caution: recent ETF outflows have made short-term flows more fragile.

4. Risks & Headwinds

Analysts warn that if ETH breaks below $3,700–$3,750, it could revisit lower support (e.g., $3,400).

There’s macro uncertainty (e.g., global market risks) that might weigh on investor sentiment.

On-chain research points to smart contract dependency risks, suggesting the ecosystem may be more fragile than it seems.

5. Long-Term Thesis

If Fusaka executes well, Ethereum’s base layer could become cheaper and more scalable, strengthening its role as the settlement layer for L2s.

Institutional adoption and staking continue to reduce ETH’s liquid supply, which may support a higher price floor over time.

title: Bitcoin's Potential Surge: A Look Ahead
subTitle:
The cryptocurrency market has been on a rollercoaster recently, with Bitcoin experiencing a significant dip below the $100,000 mark, causing jitters among traders. For a period, the crypto sector faced its most challenging conditions in months. Following the decline, Bitcoin has hovered around $90,000, and has even seen a recent drop below this level within the last 24 hours.
​However, despite this recent volatility, some analysts are predicting a positive turn for Bitcoin. Renowned market analyst, Tony Severino, known as “The Bull,” has released an updated technical forecast suggesting that Bitcoin's next move could be upward.
​Understanding the "Death Cross" and What it Means
​Severino's analysis highlights the formation of a "death cross" on Bitcoin's daily chart. This occurs when the 50-day moving average begins to cross below the 200-day moving average. While traditionally seen as a bearish signal, Severino's research indicates that the current alignment of these moving averages, along with the short-term trend line, may actually contradict the prevailing bearish sentiment on Bitcoin's chart.
​After weeks of declining momentum, the 50-day average is now trending downwards, while the 200-day average, representing the long-term uptrend, is beginning to flatten. This specific death cross formation has appeared around the $110,000 price point, leading Severino to forecast that Bitcoin could reach this level as early as next week.
​Why a Price Pump is Possible
​The behavior of these moving averages, according to Severino, creates a scenario where a price "pump" or rapid increase is conceivable. After breaking below $100,000, Bitcoin found a support level at approximately $92,000. Since then, it has been forming smaller-bodied candles, which can often be an indicator of an impending reversal in trend.
​Should buyers gain control, a swift ascent to the $103,000–$110,000 range is a possibility. However, the recent 24-hour drop below $90,000 presents a challenge to this optimistic outlook.
​For Bitcoin to reach $110,000 in the coming days, it would need to experience a substantial relief rally either before or immediately after the death cross. This typically happens when market sentiment is overly negative, leading to an influx of short positions, which then makes the price vulnerable to a rapid upward surge. To initiate such a move today, Bitcoin would first need to rebound above $90,000, demonstrating a shift in momentum away from the current sell-off.

Are you like I was back in the day, with only 10,000 to 20,000 small funds, staring at the K-line, feeling envious?

Step one: What is rolling over? How to play with small funds?

Rolling over means using leverage or contracts to snowball small capital.

In simple terms: buy low, sell high, add to your position with profits, and repeat.

Don’t blindly go all in! Start with small funds, remember the golden rule of “entering in batches.”


Starting capital: 10,000

Open contracts with low leverage. Why low leverage?

Because high leverage is a retail investor's harvesting machine! Choose mainstream coins like BTC or ETH.

Core of rolling over: layered position management.

Don’t put all your eggs in one basket! Divide into 3-5 layers:

First layer: 20% of capital, buy at a low point (e.g., when BTC hits support).
After a 10% profit, roll into the second layer to add to your position.

Set stop-loss and take-profit for each layer: exit at a 20% profit, cut at a 5% loss (don’t be soft-hearted!).

This is called “violent rolling over”: small funds leverage big, but don't be greedy; stop after 3-5 rounds.

The first time I rolled over, I had 10,000 capital
Chased ETH on the rise.

The result was a flash crash, blew up my position, and lost 8,000!

😱 Why? Didn’t set a stop-loss and got emotional.

You’ve probably also experienced the mindset of “just wait a bit for a rebound,” only to end up losing more and more.


Three golden strategies for position management

Risk control: total position shouldn’t exceed 50% of capital. Use tool apps to set alerts, and your phone will vibrate to stop-loss.


Mindset training: don’t revenge add to your position when you lose, don’t get carried away when you profit. Remember: 90% of people in crypto are retail investors because they don’t know how to manage rolling over!


Advanced techniques: combine MACD indicators, buy low and sell high.

quoteContent.body: Ethereum Foundation Proposes Interoperability Layer for Unified Layer 2 Networks
quoteContent.title: Ethereum Foundation Proposes Interoperability Layer for Unified Layer 2 Networks
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly:
According to PANews, the Ethereum Foundation's account abstraction team has introduced the Ethereum Interoperability Layer (EIL) proposal. This initiative aims to unify all Layer 2 networks into a single Ethereum chain. The proposal is based on the ERC-4337 standard and the principle of trustless declaration, allowing users to complete cross-chain transactions with a single signature without additional trust assumptions. Users can initiate and settle cross-Layer 2 operations directly from their wallets, eliminating the need for relays or solvers.

The EIL seeks to address the fragmentation issues of Layer 2 networks, simplifying token management and cross-chain transfer processes. Users only need to select the asset and address, and the wallet will automatically handle inter-chain routing and asset delivery. This approach is designed to streamline operations and enhance the efficiency of transactions across different Layer 2 networks.

title: Crypto Market Bleeds as BTC, ETH & XRP Try to Hold Their Levels
subTitle:
The crypto market is not having a great day - red dominates the charts, and the overall mood feels heavier than usual.
 The Bitcoin is still holding above $91,000, but the recent selling and the clear drop in institutional interest have made traders uneasy.
Ethereum has pushed back above $3,000, though the move doesn’t exactly inspire confidence-ETF outflows are picking up again. XRP is also trying to lift itself from support, but with retail traders mostly sitting on the sidelines, the recovery looks half-hearted.
Bitcoin: Trying to Stay Steady, But Momentum Isn’t There
The BTC dipped earlier - touched roughly - $89,253 and then bounced but the recovery is still fragile.
A technical warning sign has already appeared - the 50-day EMA has slipped below the 200-day EMA forming a Death Cross. It is basically the market’s way of saying - “Sellers are still running the show.”
For the Bitcoin to calm down and even think about another push toward $100,000, it needs to hold above $90,000 on daily closes.
If the market keeps avoiding risk the BTC could easily drift back toward the low-80s.
Ethereum - Above $3K, But Not Out of Trouble
ETH briefly slipped into the $2,900s, then pulled itself back above $3,000. Even so, the bounce doesn’t change much.
On Monday alone, U.S. ETH ETFs saw $183 million walk out the door. That’s the biggest exit in days and shows how cautious institutions are becoming.
ETH is also stuck below major moving averages - the 50-day, 100-day, and 200-day - all of which sit far above current levels. With the RSI still near oversold, sellers remain in control for now.
XRP: Recovering Slowly, But Confidence Is Thin
XRP tapped support around $2.10 and is trying to inch upward. But the October 10 crash still lingers in the minds of traders, and retail participation hasn’t bounced back since. The recovery lacks force.
Without stronger buying, XRP could slide back toward $2.07, and if pressure continues, even $1.90 could come back into play - levels seen earlier this year.

title: ETH Upgrade, Fusaka: What is it? What Does it Mean For Institutional Asset Holders?
subTitle:
Ethereum’s Fusaka upgrade is not just another protocol update, it’s a foundational shift in how Ethereum handles validator operations...
What is Fusaka and why it matters
Ethereum’s Fusaka upgrade is not just another protocol update, it’s a foundational shift in how Ethereum handles validator operations, data throughput, and infrastructure coordination. Fusaka is being trialed across existing networks like Holesky, Sepolia, and Hoodi, making it a live rehearsal for Ethereum’s future. Think of Fusaka as upgrading the operating system of Ethereum’s validator network, without changing the hardware. It improves performance, security, and scalability while keeping the core architecture intact.
What does it mean from a tech point of view?
Fusaka introduces several Ethereum Improvement Proposals (EIPs) that reshape how validators and nodes interact with the network:


PeerDAS (EIP-7594)
Ethereum’s scaling roadmap includes “blobs”, large chunks of data used primarily by rollups. Traditionally, nodes had to download entire blobs to verify them, which is bandwidth-intensive and inefficient at scale. Imagine downloading a movie by watching just a few scenes and still knowing the full plot or verifying a book’s existence by reading random pages from multiple copies. If every sampled page matches, you can trust the book is complete, without reading every word.
PeerDAS (Peer Data Availability Sampling) lets nodes verify large data blobs by sampling small parts, reducing bandwidth without sacrificing security. This is crucial for institutions running large validator fleets. Instead of downloading the full dataset, nodes check enough pieces to be statistically confident that the data exists and is retrievable.
For institutions running hundreds or thousands of validators, PeerDAS dramatically reduces network load and hardware requirements, making Ethereum more cost-effective and scalable for enterprise-grade infrastructure.
Execution Layer Enhancements
These EIPs refine how Ethereum’s execution layer handles gas, cryptography, and client coordination; critical for institutions integrating with custody platforms and compliance systems.
EIP-7823: Gas Limit Cap
What it does: Introduces a cap on gas limits to prevent unpredictable spikes.
Why it matters: Predictable gas behavior is essential for automated systems and financial modeling. It is like setting a speed limit on a highway to prevent traffic jams and accidents.
EIP-7825: ModExp Optimization
What it does: Reduces gas costs for modular exponentiation, a key operation in cryptographic functions.
Why it matters: Faster and cheaper cryptographic operations improve performance for smart contracts and validator logic. It enhances efficiency for systems using advanced cryptography (e.g., zero-knowledge proofs, secure custody).
EIP-7883: secp256r1 Support
What it does: Adds support for the secp256r1 elliptic curve*, widely used in enterprise security (e.g., TLS, hardware wallets).
Why it matters: Improves compatibility with existing enterprise infrastructure. It is like adding support for a universal plug type in a global power grid.
EIP-7935: Engine API Updates
What it does: Improves coordination between execution and consensus clients.
Why it matters: Reduces the risk of desynchronization and improves validator reliability. Ensures smoother validator operations and better monitoring across infrastructure layers.
Blob Parameter-Only Forks (BPO1 & BPO2)
Ethereum will gradually increase blob throughput, allowing more data to flow through the network without destabilizing it. These forks adjust blob throughput parameters without changing core protocol logic. Ethereum can now scale data capacity gradually, allowing rollups and data-heavy applications to grow without destabilizing the network. Think of Ethereum as a highway. Instead of opening all lanes at once, it adds lanes gradually, testing traffic flow and safety at each stage. It means higher throughput and lower latency, while maintaining network stability.
The rollout is phased:
Phase 1: 6 blobs per block / 9 MB max
Phase 2: 10 blobs / 15 MB
Phase 3: 14 blobs / 21 MB
Ethereum can now scale data capacity gradually, allowing rollups and data-heavy applications to grow without destabilizing the network.
Institutional impact: What Fusaka mean for financial institutions?
Fusaka enables operators to simulate real-world validator operations, onboarding, switching, reward tracking; before the upgrade hits mainnet. This is like running a full-scale fire drill before changing building regulations. What will change in practice? Institutions can test how Fusaka interacts with custody platforms, ensuring that staking workflows remain compliant and secure. With tools like transaction decoders and policy-gated controls, institutions can inspect every validator action before signing—no more blind trust in opaque hashes. Ethereum’s open audit competition invites external researchers to stress-test Fusaka, signaling confidence and transparency. Public release notes and synchronized client upgrades reduce fragmentation risk and build trust with institutional stakeholders.
Conclusion
The Fusaka upgrade is more than a technical milestone, it’s a strategic enabler for institutions seeking to scale Ethereum staking securely, compliantly, and efficiently. By introducing innovations like PeerDAS, execution-layer optimizations, and gradual blob throughput expansion, Ethereum is laying the groundwork for enterprise-grade validator operations.
For financial institutions, Fusaka offers:
Predictable performance: Gas caps and cryptographic enhancements reduce operational risk and improve system reliability.Custody compatibility: Support for secp256r1 and transparent transaction tooling aligns Ethereum with existing enterprise security standards.Operational confidence: Institutions can simulate full validator lifecycles before mainnet exposure, ensuring readiness across compliance, custody, and governance layers.
For staking providers managing delegated assets, Fusaka enables:
Scalable validator orchestration: Efficient sampling and batching reduce infrastructure overhead.Policy-driven control: Enhanced client coordination and transaction decoding allow for granular oversight and auditability.Futureproofing: Providers can align their infrastructure with Ethereum’s roadmap, ensuring long-term compatibility and performance.
As Ethereum prepares for Fusaka’s mainnet activation, institutions and their infrastructure partners have a rare opportunity to test, refine, and validate their staking strategies in advance. Those who act now will be best positioned to lead in the next era of decentralized finance, where scalability, security, and transparency are not just technical goals, but institutional imperatives.

* The secp256r1 elliptic curve, also known as NIST P-256, is a widely adopted cryptographic standard used in secure communications, especially in enterprise and government systems. Elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) is a form of public-key cryptography based on the algebraic structure of elliptic curves over finite fields. ECC enables secure key exchange, digital signatures, and encryption with smaller key sizes compared to traditional methods like RSA, resulting in faster performance and lower resource usage.
What Makes secp256r1 Special?
Standardized by NIST: secp256r1 is part of the suite of curves recommended by the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), making it a default choice for many enterprise systems.256-bit security: It offers strong security with relatively small key sizes, balancing performance and protection.Used in TLS/SSL: It’s the default curve in many secure web protocols (HTTPS), mobile apps, and hardware wallets.Supported by HSMs and enterprise custody platforms: Most institutional-grade cryptographic modules (like Ledger Enterprise, Fireblocks, etc.) support secp256r1 natively.

Currently, there are two voices in the market:

"Recently, all the short positions are making money. Is a bear market coming?"

"The bear market is coming, right? Then I should short quickly!"

But in reality, both bull and bear markets are outcomes that can only be seen in hindsight; they cannot be used to predict the future!

In trend trading, shorting occurs because the price has broken below a support level, not because one "feels a bear market is coming." Shorting is a process of action in the present; the bear market is merely a possible outcome later on.

If you get too hung up on bull and bear markets, it doesn't really help. After all, whether the market is bull or bear, if you can't find the right rhythm, you won't make money anyway!

As the old saying goes, people cannot earn wealth beyond their own understanding. The more you learn, the broader your perspective. A frog in a well cannot compare to a wild goose in the sky. $BTC

translatedData.content: Is the crypto market really heading into a bear market❓❗️ Recently, BTC and ETH have continued to hit new lows, with BTC and ETH both breaking below the weekly M60, which looks like a very bad signal. Now some people say we should wait for Bitcoin to reach over 50,000 to buy in; I think that may not necessarily happen. Even if it does reach 53,000, I doubt they would dare to buy the dip. The continuous decline, along with many in the community sharing news of an impending bear market, has indeed caused a lot of panic among those still holding coins, making them hesitate about whether to sell. For me, someone who has held onto ETH since the bull market of 2021 when it was over 4,800, I've already gone through several rounds of ups and downs, and I am still very anxious, worried that ETH might drop back to over 800 or 1,300. If I sell now, would that mean I could increase my holdings by buying at the bottom again? Do you guys have similar thoughts? But after calm reflection, I want to share some of my own thoughts with everyone: First of all, is it really a bear market? This round of Ethereum hasn't even reached 5,000 yet. If we really enter a bear market, how low could it go? The last round was over 4,800, with a low of over 800. This round, if it stays below 5,000, proportionally the lowest point could be over 900. Can you withstand 900? If you can, then don't worry, prepare your bullets; if it really drops to over 900, go in decisively. Even if it goes to zero, don't regret it. Of course, I'm talking about a more extreme situation; all investments must be within your acceptable range. Secondly, I think this decline is different from previous ones; the feeling of a real bear market is that it drops steadily without giving you a chance to sell on the rebound, but this time is different. It drops for half a day and bounces back for half a day, resembling a bull market, indicating that there is still a significant divergence of opinions between bulls and bears. Lastly, I want to say that I don't think this round of increases can be considered a real bull market. The doubling of Bitcoin can be called a bull market, but which of the other mainstream coins, besides BNB, has doubled from its previous peak? What kind of bull market is this? The push-up this round is mainly driven by positive policies towards ETFs. If we follow the bear market theory, there's one point that doesn't make sense. Although the four-year cycle indicates we should go into a bear market, it is inevitable that the Federal Reserve will start injecting liquidity. It's unlikely that we can have a bear market while simultaneously injecting liquidity. Looking at the community, two years ago, someone invested 1.3 million to hold BNB and recently exited with 16 million, I really admire his patience and investment philosophy. From the 3rd to the 10th of the month, he was an aggressive accumulator, scooping up nearly 31,000 #ETH at an average price of $3,581, a $110 million bet that the bottom was in.
He believed in the rally. He embraced the volatility. But as the market continued its inexorable, downward slide, his resolve finally shattered.
In a moment of capitulation, The Dip-Buyer dumped his entire position: 31,005 ETH for $92 million.
The cost of his failed conviction was paid in full: a stomach-churning, definitive $18.8 million loss in just two weeks. It’s a painful, universal lesson echoing across every volatile market: sometimes, when you are convinced you are catching the floor, you're only guaranteed to catch a falling knife.

title: نشاط حيتان الإيثريوم (Ethereum Whales Activity) في 18 نوفمبر 2025
subTitle:
#whale 
#ETH 
 يشهد الإيثريوم $ETH  نشاطًا ملحوظًا من الحيتان (المحافظ الكبيرة التي تمتلك أكثر من 10,000 ETH عادةً)، خاصة مع تراجع السعر الحالي إلى حوالي 3,300-3,500 دولار أمريكي. الحيتان تركز على "شراء الانخفاض" (buy the dip) أثناء التقلبات، مما يشير إلى ثقة طويلة الأمد رغم الضغوط المؤقتة من المستثمرين الصغار. إليك أبرز النقاط المتعلقة بالنشاط اليومي والأخير (مع التركيز على الأحداث من 17-18 نوفمبر):
أبرز معاملات الشراء والتراكم:
تراكمArthur Hayes# (تاجر بارز): قام Hayes بتدوير 1,480 ETH (بقيمة 4.7 مليون دولار) كجزء من سلسلة معاملات على مدار يومين، بالإضافة إلى أصول كريبتو أخرى. هذا يعكس استراتيجية إعادة تخصيص نحو ETH أثناء الضعف السعري.
إعادة تنشيط محفظة ICO قديمة (من 2014): محفظة نائمة من عصر ICO الأولى أصبحت نشطة مرة أخرى، مما أثار اهتمام السوق بسبب حجمها الكبير وحركة ملايين الدولارات في ETH وتوكنات أخرى. هذه الحركات تزيد من السيولة وتؤثر على التقلبات قصيرة الأجل.
تراكم جماعي حديث (من الأسبوع الماضي، يمتد إلى اليوم): زادت محافظ الحيتان الكبرى (10K-100K ETH) بنسبة 0.9% في الربع الثالث من 2025، لتصل إلى 22.31 مليون ETH. في الثلاثة أيام الماضية (5-7 نوفمبر، مع استمرار الاتجاه)، اشترت الحيتان $ETH  بقيمة 1.37 مليار دولار، وهو أحد أكبر التراكمات في العام.
السياق العام والتأثيرات:
التباين بين الحيتان والمستثمرين الصغار: بينما يبيع المستثمرون الصغار (100-10K ETH) بمعدل سريع (خسروا 140K ETH في الفترة الأخيرة)، يتراكم الحيتان عبر قروض مستقرة (مثل Aave) وقنوات OTC. مثال: مستثمر مجهول اشترى 70 مليون دولار ETH في يومين، وآخر أضاف 206 مليون دولار في AaveETH.
التأثير على السعر: رغم الانخفاض إلى 3,331 دولار (بسبب كسر الدعم عند 3,300 دولار)، يُعتبر هذا التراكم إشارة إيجابية. التاريخ يظهر أن مثل هذه الحركات غالبًا ما تسبق ارتفاعات بنسبة 25-30%، مع توقعات للوصول إلى 5,000 دولار بنهاية 2025 إذا استمر الدعم.
عوامل داعمة: أكثر من 32 مليون ETH مستثمرة (staked)، مما يقلل الضغط البيعي. كما أن تدفقات ETF بلغت 5.4 مليار دولار في الفترة الأخيرة، وتحسينات الشبكة (مثل Layer 2) تزيد من الثقة.

🔥The truth about ETH's decline has arrived: Bitmine has stopped, and no one is picking up the slack...






Matrixport's analysis this time is quite accurate.

The risk for ETH actually started building two weeks ago.


Who was the core force supporting the market during the summer?

Bitmine.


Most of the incremental buying in the market

was basically being propped up by Bitmine as an institution.


Now that Bitmine has stopped buying,

this is the real problem for ETH.


The ETF has already attracted nearly 10 billion USD,

long positions have also been relatively high,

but there is simply no new capital to take over.


In the absence of anyone picking up the slack,

prices are bound to seek support downwards.


ETH has already corrected 10% this year,

since the first warning about risks started,

this wave of decline is also close to 20%.


The pace of deleveraging by longs

is almost identical to previous data judgments.


Without new money and no one taking over,

sentiment is unreliable,

and in the end, it just leaves the word "decline."


So to say an old saying (which is also the hardest to do):

Trading based on data

is much stronger than trading based on sentiment or words.
#ETH
